items.title: Every invertible module on a locally Noetherian scheme without embedded points has a regular meromorphic section
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma says that on a locally Noetherian scheme without embedded points every invertible module admits a regular meromorphic section (statement lines 6348-6353). The counted proof is short and complete: it chooses a generator of the rank one free module at each generic point over the artinian local ring there and observes that the product of these generators is a regular meromorphic section, which follows from the description of meromorphic sections as products over the generic points (proof lines 6355-6360). It is H2: the construction is carried out in the counted span, with the cited input being the product description of meromorphic sections established earlier in the chapter.
